about.title: About Le Canot à Pixels
about.lead: A retro video game collection, rooted in Lavaltrie, Québec.
about.storyBody: Le Canot à Pixels ("the pixel canoe") takes its name from the {legendLink}, still very much alive in Lavaltrie: a flying canoe that carried lumberjacks home in a single night. Here, the canoe carries something else: retro video games that get back into play instead of sleeping in a box in the basement.
about.seekBody: The collection grows with every find. We are always on the lookout for retro titles, especially the ones on our wanted list. Got a game that might interest us? Write to us: we look at everything and reply quickly.
about.collectionBody: Every game in the collection has its own page: console, edition, condition and photos when available. Interested in a title? We remain open, simply and gladly, to trades between collectors — write to us and we'll talk.
about.sourceBody: Core information (title, console, edition, condition) is imported from PriceCharting. Site-specific statuses and notes are managed locally.
about.disclaimerBody: When a real photo is not available, a reference cover is shown and clearly flagged. The actual item may differ from the image.
